records.origin_description: Phase 4.5B declarative research-program tracks built from the existing canonical technology catalog.
records.transformation: Phase 4.5B organizes existing technology definitions into six named declarative tracks. Each program references existing technology IDs and canonical research-program dependency IDs. Declared research_cost values are sums of direct target technology research costs; research_duration_months values sum direct target technology durations as a sequential planning estimate. Program-level thresholds are simulation calibration parameters. No executable program state, project progress, completion authority, or technology effects are added.
records.license: Project-local internal artifact.
records.notes: Internal content organization, not an assertion of country-specific historical research spending or program implementation. Cost and duration values are derived planning summaries only; each per-technology cost, duration, historical gate, progress, completion, and effect remains governed by existing technology/runtime contracts. ResearchSystem / ResearchComponent / ResearchProject remain runtime authorities.

records.origin_description: Phase 3.1 canonical resource catalog
records.transformation: Phase 4.1A semantic metadata was retained. Phase 4.1B adds a narrow Level 1 resource set (natural gas, electric power, fertilizer, cement, and chemicals) as internal catalog definitions. No existing country/resource magnitude was reinterpreted, and no unsupported physical units were assigned.
records.license: Project-local internal artifact.
records.notes: The Phase 3.1 baseline remains the provenance reference. Level 1 expansion is an internal content enrichment; physical unit resolution remains unresolved where authoritative evidence is absent.

records.origin_description: Phase 4.4A technology catalog foundation migrated from the existing TechnologyData / DefaultTechnologies runtime definitions.
records.transformation: Field-preserving migration of the existing ten DefaultTechnologies definitions into a declarative catalog. No new technology definition was invented, no historical end years were inferred, and effect values remain semantically unitless until a later causal effect contract defines their consumers.
records.license: Project-local internal artifact.
records.notes: advanced_steelmaking remains a reference-only canonical technology identity sourced from the production-process catalog and is intentionally not promoted to a full technology definition in Phase 4.4A.
